subject: [PATCH v3 2/4] mm: memcg: read root lruvec stats from the node counters

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the way the root memory cgroup's (memcg) LRU vector stats are read by using the node counters instead of flushing the entire system when possible. This is done for most memcg node stats, which only track memory charged to a memcg, and the root memcg's hierarchical value equals the node counter. However, certain kernel memory stats, hugetlb, and WORKINGSET_NODERECLAIM still require reading the rstat value due to accounting complexities. The patch also updates the way these stats are reported in the cgroup v1 memory.numa_stat, making it more accurate but potentially mismatching with the root memcg's memory.stat.
